Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
Department Overview
Department Description
Innovation is the oxygen of our company, and in 2023, we invested more than US$850 million in research and development (R&D). We’re now opening a new Research & Development Centre in Cork, Ireland focused on designing software for the company’s comprehensive land mobile radio (LMR) portfolio, with plans for expansion across other technologies in the future.
Motorola Solutions’ ecosystem of technologies is centred on safety and security, with LMR representing a foundational core. The company has deployed more than 13,000 LMR networks worldwide, trusted by governments and enterprises for highly secure communications designed to work in the most extreme conditions. Modernised with broadband and advanced data applications, LMR remains at the forefront of providing public safety agencies with the communications they rely on and need.
You’ll be part of our diverse and experienced global team, developing meaningful solutions that support thousands of public safety agencies and enterprises worldwide in solving complex safety and security challenges. Come join our team to work on real-world projects with a real-world impact.
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Android Applications Developer to design, build, and maintain mission-critical Android applications supporting public-safety communication, situational awareness, and operational data systems. These applications are used by emergency responders and must operate reliably in demanding field environments with intermittent connectivity, device integrations, and high availability requirements.
The successful candidate will collaborate with product management, UI/UX, backend platform teams, and device integration teams to deliver secure, resilient, and performance-optimized applications, while driving engineering excellence, architectural consistency, and technical mentorship across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain mission-critical Android applications using Kotlin-first development practices.
Implement resilient, offline-capable, and fault-tolerant mobile solutions capable of operating in low-connectivity or degraded network environments.
Build modern Android user interfaces using Jetpack Compose while ensuring usability in high-stress operational workflows.
Implement scalable, modular architectures (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) supporting large multi-feature applications.
Integrate with backend systems, real-time messaging platforms, and device services using REST, streaming, and event-driven APIs.
Develop and maintain integrations with Bluetooth, radio communication interfaces, sensors, GPS/location, and background services.
Optimize applications for performance, battery efficiency, and reliability under continuous operational use.
Implement secure communication, authentication, and data-protection mechanisms aligned with enterprise and public-safety security requirements.
Contribute to automated testing, reliability validation, and release quality gates including unit, integration, and instrumentation testing.
Support CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and operational monitoring of deployed mobile applications.
Participate in technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and promote engineering best practices across teams.
Diagnose field issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes for production deployments.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience developing production Android applications using Kotlin and the Android SDK.
Experience designing high-reliability, enterprise, or mission-critical mobile applications.
Experience with modern Android UI development using Jetpack Compose.
Strong knowledge of Android architecture components (ViewModel, Navigation, Lifecycle, WorkManager).
Experience implementing offline-first data synchronization, caching, and conflict-handling strategies.
Experience working with Bluetooth, device integrations, background processing, or hardware-adjacent APIs.
Experience with networking frameworks such as Retrofit, OkHttp, or Ktor.
Strong debugging, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
Experience working with Git-based development workflows.
Strong collaboration and communication skills within cross-functional engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on public safety, communications, defense, or highly regulated enterprise mobile platforms.
Experience integrating with radio communication systems, push-to-talk, messaging, or real-time communication frameworks.
Experience implementing secure mobile architectures including certificate-based authentication, encrypted storage, and hardened builds.
Experience with dependency injection frameworks (Hilt/Dagger).
Familiarity with modular Android architectures for large-scale applications.
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments supporting multi-team product releases.
Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for sharing business logic across mobile or cross-platform applications.
Familiarity with Compose Multiplatform for building shared UI components across Android and other supported platforms.
Experience with Firebase, observability platforms, or operational telemetry tooling.

None

None

Experienced

jobs.title: Civil Structural Engineer
jobs.desc:
Civil / Structural Engineer
About Us
Arcadis is the world’s leading company in sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy for natural and built assets. With over 36,000 professionals in 70+ countries, we are united in improving quality of life and solving the world’s most complex challenges.
Location/s
: Based in our Little Island, Cork offices.
Role description:
Reporting to the CSA Department Manager, the Civil / Structural Engineer will be a member of the CSA Department supporting the delivery of civil and structural design services for major pharmaceutical and industrial clients. The role will have a predominantly civil engineering focus, with primary responsibility for underground drainage, underground electrical and utility services, site development works and drainage impact assessments. The Civil / Structural Engineer will also undertake structural engineering design and support structural project delivery as required.
The successful candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams, taking responsibility for civil engineering deliverables from concept, planning, basic design, detailed design, tender and construction. The post-holder will be expected to deliver and manage their own design scope, coordinate inputs from other disciplines and deliver technically robust solutions to agreed programme and quality requirements.
The Civil / Structural Engineer will work closely with Architects, Structural Engineers, building services engineers and other discipline teams to ensure civil and structural designs are coordinated, compliant and suitable for construction. The post-holder is expected to demonstrate the Arcadis Core Values at all times.
Key Responsibilities
Interface with client design teams, local authorities, utility providers and project stakeholders as required.
Take responsibility for the delivery of civil engineering design scope within agreed budget and programme.
Prepare engineering calculations, drainage impact assessments, reports, specifications, schedules and design documentation.
Design foul, surface water and process drainage systems, including gravity and pumped systems, attenuation, flow control and SuDS measures.
Design and coordinate underground water mains, electrical ducting, utility corridors and other buried services, including clash avoidance and interfaces with foundations and external works.
Prepare site development designs including roads, pavements, levels, earthworks and external works drainage.
Undertake structural design and assessment work, including reinforced concrete and structural steelwork, foundations, equipment supports and modifications to existing structures.
Coordinate surveys, ground investigation information and utility records, and identify design risks or information gaps.
Lead or contribute to technical, constructability, safety and compliance reviews.
Support planning, statutory consent and BC(A)R compliance activities where required.
Coordinate design activities with architecture, structural, process, mechanical, electrical and other disciplines.
Identify and communicate technical issues that may impact quality, cost or schedule.
Attend and contribute to design, client and site meetings as required.
Undertake site visits during construction and support the resolution of requests for information and technical queries.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental procedures, checklists and technical guidance.
Promote Arcadis Behavioural Standards and Equality, Diversity & Inclusion.
Minimum 5 years post-graduate design experience, with a predominantly civil engineering background. Experience in the industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences or similarly regulated sectors is preferred.
A third-level qualification in Civil Engineering or Civil / Structural Engineering.
Chartered Engineer status or membership of a recognised professional body is preferred, ideally MIEI.
Why Arcadis?
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
We’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone thrives. Through six ED&I workstreams—Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+, and Race—we foster innovation by embracing diverse perspectives.
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, EMEA
jobs.desc:
About Nooks.ai
Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.
Today, over 2000 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we've at least tripled ARR each year for 3 years running.
Title:
Founding Solutions Engineer (EMEA)
Location:
Primary: Dublin; secondary: Remote, UK or Ireland
About The Role
Nooks is the Agent Workspace for Sales, where reps and AI agents don’t just execute tasks, they decide next moves, with intelligence that compounds over time. We’re growing fast (4x YoY since Series B), our customers spend 4+ hours a day inside Nooks, and the SE function is one of the highest-leverage bets in the business: SE-supported deals close at nearly 6x the rate of unsupported ones.
As our
first Solutions Engineer in EMEA
, you’ll partner with the founding EMEA GTM team to build the territory and establish how we win technically in the region. You’ll own technical discovery, demos, and trial strategy while building the processes, tools, and customer experiences that make the motion repeatable.
You’ll have an established global SE foundation to build on, alongside substantial ownership of what needs to work differently in EMEA. That means adapting our playbook to regional buying processes, creating new approaches where needed, and turning early customer learning into a stronger sales motion.
We’re looking for someone who enjoys both winning deals and building the systems behind them. If you’re a seller who thinks like an engineer, or an engineer who’s found their competitive edge in the deal, this is built for you.
What You'll Do
Own the technical win across EMEA: Lead the full technical sales lifecycle across concurrent opportunities, from discovery and demo through trial and close, with a clear mandate to drive each to a decision.
Build the territory with the founding EMEA GTM team: Partner with AEs and regional leadership on account strategy, customer engagement, and the technical approach needed to create and win early opportunities.
Create an EMEA-specific SE motion: Adapt and build discovery frameworks, demo narratives, trial plans, success criteria, and handoffs that reflect regional customer needs and buying processes.
Connect technical discovery to business outcomes: Get underneath feature requests to uncover real business pain, then build a solution narrative tied to executive priorities and measurable value.
Lead prospect trials: Serve as the primary technical contact, establish clear evaluation plans, monitor trial health, flag risks early, and intervene before issues threaten the deal.
Navigate complex evaluations: Coordinate with internal experts on integrations, security, data handling, and procurement requirements, keeping customers aligned on a credible path forward.
Build the regional operating foundation: Create reusable assets, document what works, and introduce automation that helps a small team cover more opportunities effectively.
Connect the EMEA field to Product: Translate recurring customer needs, competitive insights, and trial patterns into actionable feedback for Product and the global SE team.
Help shape future SE growth in EMEA: Codify the regional playbook and contribute to onboarding and developing future teammates as the business grows.
What You Bring
Prior experience in a quota-carrying or technical sales role, such as AE, SE, or hybrid, with ownership of the pre-sale cycle.
Experience supporting EMEA customers and navigating regional buying processes, stakeholder dynamics, and technical evaluations.
A builder’s mindset: you can create a process, test it in live deals, and improve it without waiting for a complete playbook.
A sales-first instinct: you treat trials like pipeline, care deeply about win rates, and build urgency around real customer priorities.
The ability to engage senior stakeholders, including CROs, CTOs, and VPs of Sales, and lead discovery or a business review independently.
Technical curiosity and sound reasoning: you understand how systems connect, investigate unfamiliar requirements, and close knowledge gaps independently.
Strong discovery skills: you ask “why is that a requirement?” before answering it and develop a point of view before prescribing a solution.
The judgment to prioritize across active deals and foundational work, knowing when to solve something yourself and when to involve global partners.
A bias toward action and comfort owning ambiguous, undocumented work as the first SE in a new region.
Early regional expansion or founding-team experience is a strong plus, as is familiarity with MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or an equivalent enterprise sales methodology.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

Part-time available
Pay:

Real opportunities to grow — we love promoting from within

A fun, supportive team that genuinely cares

Clean and sanitise work surfaces, floors, sinks, equipment and utensils throughout the day so the kitchen stays safe and ready to use.

Clean kitchen equipment properly, follow the correct cleaning procedures and help make sure everything is stored safely and where it should be.

If you have time outside of cleaning, you can help with basic food prep, washing and preparing ingredients, and getting the kitchen set up for the day.
Stay on top of cleaning
Work through cleaning checklists, spot jobs that need doing and take action rather than waiting to be asked.
Keep food and people safe
Follow food safety, allergen, hygiene and health & safety procedures carefully at all times.
Jump in when it gets busy

You take real pride in keeping things clean and organised
You notice when something needs doing and get on with it
You don’t mind getting stuck into the less glamorous jobs
You like being busy and working as part of a team
You’re reliable and someone people can count on
You care about doing things properly and safely
You’re curious and happy to learn new skills
You like the idea of growing into other kitchen roles over time
If you’re looking for a role where cleaning is someone else’s job or where you can leave things for the next shift, this probably isn’t the one.

Our team is technically progressive and offers a wonderful opportunity for you to work with like‑minded specialists. Within AtkinsRéalis, we operate national and international technical networks to develop and share the very best ideas and practice in our industry. We encourage the production of papers/articles and support our staff in presenting their work at conferences. We actively support staff in their career progression. This is an exceptional environment for you to develop your technical and commercial skills.
We value flexible working and encourage working from different offices across Ireland, flexible hours and home working; you can also work for 20 days a year away from your home base. We also support part‑time workers who make up an essential component of our team. The role can be based any of offices in Ireland, namely Dublin, Cork, Dundalk or Galway.
We work for clients across the Ireland, including central government, regulators, Uisce Eireann and local authorities, among others. We have a strong pipeline of work secured with multiple entities on a wide range of projects. We are leading on a variety of unique water industry projects which offer excellent opportunities.
Your role
To lead the undertaking of Water Framework Directive compliance assessments.
Lead technical WFD chapters for EIARs.
To support in work winning activities to secure more WFD focused work.
Collaborative working with other Water Management Consultancy, and the wider network of AtkinsRéalis' specialists, to ensure projects are compliant with the Water Framework Directive legislation.
Liaise with internal and external project teams to deliver the best environmental outcomes for affected projects to ensure WFD compliance.
To work with others in the standardisation and automisation of the WFD assessment process.
To work effectively as part of a team and with other professionals (environmental scientists, ecologists, water quality specialists, hydrologist, hydrogeologists, hydromorphologists, engineers, and planners) throughout AtkinsRéalis, to provide a consistent and integrated service to our clients.
To work collaboratively with the wider team delegating to, reviewing the work of and mentoring more junior staff.
To succeed within this role, you must have a flexible, 'hands‑on', proactive approach to your work and be able to demonstrate significant consultancy experience. You must be able to work independently as well as part of a wider team and be comfortable applying your skills in a commercial environment.

jobs.title: Production Planner
jobs.desc:
About Munters
Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical processes. Through innovative and energy-efficient technologies, we enable customers across industries to control humidity, temperature, and energy use efficiently. Together, we support our customers in optimizing performance while contributing to a healthier planet.
With more than 70 years of experience, Munters serves industries such as Data Centers, Battery production, Food, Pharma, and Manufacturing worldwide. We combine innovation, sustainability, and engineering expertise to create solutions that make a real difference for both our customers and the environment.
At Munters, you will be part of a collaborative and international organization where continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and personal growth are encouraged. Come as you are and be part of our journey.
Main Areas Of Responsibilities
Production Planning and Scheduling
Develop and maintain production schedules that align with customer demand, sales forecasts, and manufacturing capacity. This involves analysing customer orders, sales projections, and manufacturing capabilities to create detailed production plans that outline the sequence and timing of production activities.
Analyse production requirements, material availability, and labour resources to optimize production planning. This involves assessing the materials, components, and labour needed for each product, identifying potential constraints, and adjusting the production schedule to ensure efficient resource utilization and timely order fulfilment.
Schedule production activities to ensure smooth flow of materials, efficient resource utilization, and timely completion of orders. This involves breaking down production processes into individual tasks, assigning tasks to specific workstations or teams, and coordinating the movement of materials and components throughout the production process.
Production Process Optimization
Analyse production processes to identify areas for improvement, potential bottlenecks, and waste reduction opportunities. This involves conducting detailed process reviews, collecting data on process performance, and identifying areas where efficiency can be enhanced, lead times can be reduced, and costs can be minimized.
Implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, reduce lead times, and minimize production costs. This involves developing and implementing process changes, such as streamlining workflows, introducing new technologies, or adopting lean manufacturing principles, to achieve operational excellence.
Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to optimize production processes and ensure adherence to quality standards. This involves working closely with engineering teams to design and implement process improvements, and collaborating with operations teams to ensure that new processes are effectively implemented and monitored for adherence to quality standards.
You will also be expected to carry out any additional duties that may be assigned to you by the company from time to time.

jobs.desc:

17/11/2026
Location:
Cork , Ireland, Ireland
Contract type:
Temporary

4944
LEO Pharma Cork are currently recruiting a
Process Operator
to join our team on a
12-month Fixed Term Contract
- Apply Today!
LEO Pharma is uniquely positioned to make a significant difference for patients. We focus on high-risk patient groups and supporting healthcare systems with high quality medicines. With 80 years’ experience, we empower healthcare professionals with expert treatments for illnesses involving blood clots and other critical-care conditions.
In Production we share a “challenge accepted” mindset and are guided by our winning behaviours of simplification, collaboration, and accountability, to achieve our goals. The ideal candidate will be able to work independently as well as part of a small team.
Your Role
As a Process Operator, you will help deliver safe, compliant production at our Cork site. Working within a team coordinated by the Process Flow Specialist and reporting to the Operations Manager, you will follow established procedures, maintain accurate records and support reliable manufacturing operations. Your attention to detail will matter at every stage, from receiving materials to completing production activities.
Your primary responsibilities will be to:
Produce with precision: Manufacture heparin intermediates and APIs according to Standard Operating Procedures, operating production equipment and associated valves, pumps, services and utilities.
Maintain quality and compliance: Follow current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP), applicable Irish, EU and FDA requirements, and controlled-area hygiene and garbing procedures.
Manage materials accurately: Receive, weigh, measure, label and reconcile materials, complete stock-control transactions and carry out required batch sampling.
Keep operations safe and production-ready: Follow health, safety, security and environmental procedures, handle chemicals safely, prepare fittings for autoclaving, and clean and disinfect production areas.
Document and improve: Complete batch manufacturing records, logbooks and in-process control sheets, while actively contributing to performance improvement and Lean Manufacturing initiatives.
Your work will also include ethanol receipt, regenerated ethanol back-loading, operation of the ethanol distillation column, and effluent pH control and calibration. You will comply with the LEO Code of Conduct and site HR policies throughout your work.
This role offers varied, practical responsibilities across production and material handling, with opportunities to contribute ideas that improve day-to-day operations.
Please note:
This role requires shift working and the site currently runs 24/5 so flexibility is required.
Your Qualifications
You will bring a technical foundation and the ability to apply procedures accurately in a regulated production environment. The key qualifications and capabilities are:
A Level 5 Certificate or higher in science, chemical or industrial engineering. Equivalent experience may also be considered.
Previous experience in a similar role within API manufacturing, biotechnology or bioprocessing.
Knowledge of cGMP and its application to production, hygiene and documentation.
The ability to operate equipment and handle production materials safely and accurately.
The ability to maintain clear manufacturing records and contribute to continuous improvement.
As an individual, you are dependable, attentive to detail and comfortable working collaboratively. You take responsibility for your work, communicate clearly and bring a willingness to learn.
Your New Team
You will join the Operations team at LEO Pharma Cork, working alongside colleagues involved in API production. Your team is coordinated by the Process Flow Specialist, and you will report to the Operations Manager. You will also collaborate with Maintenance, QC and Quality Assurance to support safe, compliant operations and practical improvements.
Your Application
You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from including a photograph.
Beyond the skin
At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.
For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.
Join us on our journey Beyond the Skin. Apply today!

Serve as the primary contact for customer inquiries related to shipping and distribution, ensuring prompt issue resolution.

hers

, making sure all waste generated throughout the day is collected, sorted and disposed of correctly. You'll also help with general cleaning and keeping the Hot Drop Location tidy and ready for the following day.
If you're someone who loves a good checklist, here's what your day might look like:
Collect, sort and dispose of waste generated during the daily lunch service.
Manage bins and ensure waste is separated and disposed of correctly.
Keep waste disposal areas clean, tidy and organised.
Empty, clean and maintain bins as required.
Clean floors, worktops, surfaces and general work areas.
Wash and clean equipment used during the daily lunch service.
Follow daily cleaning schedules and waste management procedures.
Maintain high standards of hygiene and food safety in accordance with HACCP guidelines and EHO requirements.
Help ensure everything is clean, organised and ready for the following school day.
It's only a couple of hours each day, but it's an important job! After all, nobody wants to start their morning surrounded by yesterday's mess!
What We're Looking For
We're looking for doers – people who are sound, reliable and genuinely take pride in doing a good job.
You don't need years of cleaning experience or a qualification in making things sparkle. What matters most is having a good attitude and being willing to get stuck in!
Ideally, you'll be someone who:
Takes pride in keeping things clean and organised.
Is comfortable handling waste and carrying out waste disposal duties.
Is reliable, punctual and hardworking.
Can work independently and manage their time effectively.
Is happy to get stuck into practical, hands-on tasks.
Can follow cleaning, waste management and hygiene procedures.
Has good attention to detail.
You'll also need to be able to
read and understand English
to follow cleaning instructions and health and safety procedures.
Previous cleaning experience would be great, but it's not essential. We're happy to show you the ropes!
I still have questions actually…
No problem! We're here to answer them.
When will I work?
This role is offered on a part-time basis, Monday through Friday!
You'll work approximately
2 hours per day
, with typical hours of
12:30pm – 2:30pm
.
There may be some flexibility required depending on the needs of the Hot Drop Location.
Will I have to work all year long?
No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar.
That means you'll work during the school term and enjoy the school holidays off!
What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?
Well, for starters – a genuinely supportive team who've got your back!
The short daily shifts make this a great opportunity if you're looking for something that fits around family life, other commitments or simply want a few hours of work during the school day.
You'll also be part of a team that's helping provide hot, nutritious meals to children across Ireland.
How much is it paid?
It's THE question everybody is asking!
The same way we take care of the children in schools, we take care of our people.
You'll earn
€14.65 per hour
.
Sound like your kind of job?
If you're reliable, hardworking and don't mind rolling up your sleeves to keep things clean and organised, we'd love to hear from you!
Come join The Lunch Bag and help us keep changing children's lives, one lunch at a time! 😊

jobs.title: School meal worker (Hot Drop) - Sea Box
jobs.desc:
A Little Bit About Us
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference - and fits into your day-to-day routine?
At The Lunch Bag, we deliver healthy, hot school meals to children across Ireland. We're the country’s leading school meal provider, and we’re on a mission to help children build healthy habits for life.
We’re changing children’s lives, one lunch at a time. Are you flexible, bubbly, and keen to bring a little extra joy to the school day? We’re looking for people who want to help us keep driving forward and doing something great. Bonus? You’re off when the schools are!
So, what’s the job?
We’re on the hunt for School Lunch Operatives – reliable, cheerful people who take pride in doing things right and bring a bit of warmth to every school day.
Think of yourself as the final link in the lunch chain. All meals are prepared in our headquarters in Nenagh, Tipperary, and then delivered to the Hot Drop Locations. It’s from there that you’ll take over. Your duties will consist of heating the meals in the oven, loading them into vans and driving them to the schools.
If you’re a detail addict and thought this was a little vague, here’s a list for you:
Load pre-packaged school meals into ovens.
Turn on oven and heat meals to specific temperature according to HACCP guidelines.
Unload ovens and load into vans.
Drive the lunches in a company vehicle to the local schools.
Ensure adequate stock levels.
Follow and maintain work and cleaning schedule.
Maintain temperature and cleaning records.
HACCP and Manual Handling Training will be provided.
What we’re looking for
Since you’ll be representing The Lunch Bag in schools, we’re looking for doers - people who are sound, good-natured, and genuinely care about doing a good job. Our values matter to us, and to keep improving the lives of children across the country, we need people who share that same goal.
We’re not asking for bodybuilders, but you do need to be able to lift 14kg boxes as part of the job. You may also need to climb some stairs – not every facility in Ireland has a lift
Working for children is really rewarding – their cute little faces can brighten your day... just don’t let them get hungry or they’ll turn into tiny monsters! So we’re looking for someone who can work quickly, stay calm under pressure, and still do things properly.
All you need is the ability to read English, have full clean Irish driving license, and heat each lunch with care.
We’re looking for cheerful people who like being out and about. Teleportation would make life easier, but until that arrives, we need drivers who are happy to take a roughly one-hour trip to deliver meals to local schools.
I still have questions actually…
No problem! We’re here to answer them.
When will I work?
This job is offered on a part-time basis, Monday through Friday! Typical start times would be 8:30 am with some flexibility required as start time may be a little earlier or later.
Will I have to work all year long?
No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar. As a result, you will work with us approx 183 days of the year and will have the rest off to enjoy some well-deserved rest! Our staff sign on to Social Welfare as Educational Sector Workers during the summer months.
What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?
Well, for starters - a genuinely supportive team who’ve got your back.
The role’s flexible, ideal if you’re looking to ease back into work or just want something steady during school terms.
How much is it paid?
It’s THE question everybody is asking! The same way we take care of the children in the schools, we take care of our people. You will earn €14.65 per hour – 50c above minimum wage.

jobs.desc:
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Specialist
Locations:
Galway, Dublin, Cork, Sligo or Kilkenny
Join Us in Shaping the Future of Sustainable Development
Are you an experienced environmental assessment professional looking to make a meaningful contribution to complex projects across Ireland? As an EIA Specialist within Tetra Tech’s leading EIA/SEA Team, you will coordinate multi-disciplinary environmental inputs, support the delivery of high-quality assessment and planning documentation, and help shape projects across the transport, water, energy, natural environment and built environment sectors.
This is an opportunity to work on challenging, high-value projects while developing your project management, technical, commercial and client relationship skills within a collaborative and supportive team.
Purpose & Scope Of The Role
The EIA Specialist will support the successful delivery of environmental assessment projects from inception through to completion. Working as part of Tetra Tech’s Environment, Planning and Renewables division, the role will involve coordinating multi-disciplinary environmental assessment inputs and associated planning documentation, managing project programmes, deliverables, interfaces and competing priorities, and supporting the preparation and delivery of EIA, SEA and related environmental assessment projects. The EIA Specialist will oversee and guide junior team members and sub-consultants, liaise with clients, project teams and relevant stakeholders, and support scope and fee development, budgeting, forecasting and financial control. The role will also ensure that project outputs are technically robust, well coordinated and compliant with relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation, while contributing to client relationship development, business growth and the continuous improvement of team processes and deliverables. Working across a varied portfolio of projects and sectors, the successful candidate will collaborate with specialists from across the wider business to deliver practical, high-quality environmental advice.
Your Impact In This Position
In the short term, you will become an integral member of the EIA/SEA Team, providing dependable coordination of project inputs, programmes and deliverables while helping to ensure that project teams remain aligned, deadlines are achieved and clients receive clear, accurate and high-quality outputs. As you develop in the role, you will take increasing ownership of EIA and SEA projects, strengthen your project management and commercial capabilities, and support the development of junior colleagues and sub-consultants. Over the longer term, you will have the opportunity to build trusted relationships with clients and project stakeholders, contribute to winning and growing work in existing and new markets, support the successful delivery of complex environmental assessment projects, develop a strong professional reputation in environmental assessment, contribute to a high-performing, collaborative and technically respected team, and maintain and extend your professional knowledge through continuous professional development.
Core Capabilities
EIA/SEA Technical Expertise & Environmental Assessment Coordination
The successful candidate will have substantial experience working in an environmental assessment consultancy or regulatory environment, with a proven track record in EIA and/or SEA. Typically, they will have at least five years’ relevant experience in EIA coordination or EIA project management, together with experience coordinating planning applications and associated environmental documentation. Familiarity with relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation, including the EIA Directive and associated transposing Regulations, is essential. Knowledge of Appropriate Assessment and/or Strategic Environmental Assessment would be advantageous.
Project Management, Commercial & Delivery
The successful candidate will be able to take ownership of projects from inception through to completion and will have experience supporting Project Managers in delivering work to client expectations. They will be able to prioritise multiple projects while balancing client requirements, available resources and deadlines, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality work within agreed timescales and budgets. Commercial awareness is also important, including experience or understanding of scope development, budgeting, forecasting and cost control, as well as the ability to manage project risks, programmes, interfaces and deliverables across multi-disciplinary teams.
Leadership, Team Coordination & Stakeholder Management
The successful candidate will have experience overseeing, guiding or managing junior team members and sub-consultants, together with strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate, guide and support others. They will demonstrate excellent organisational, coordination, verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work effectively as part of multi-disciplinary project teams. The ability to liaise constructively with clients and relevant stakeholders is essential, as is a client-focused, pragmatic and collaborative approach to project delivery.
Reporting, Documentation & Compliance
The successful candidate will be able to produce and coordinate clear, accurate and timely environmental assessment and planning documentation, supported by strong report-writing and document coordination skills. They will be capable of managing and integrating multiple technical inputs while ensuring that work is delivered in line with internal procedures, relevant legislation and industry standards. Experience supporting quality assurance and maintaining consistency and traceability across project deliverables is also required.
Client Relationships & Business Development
The successful candidate will be able to build and strengthen relationships with existing clients, maintaining a strong focus on client satisfaction and achieving constructive project outcomes. They will have the ability to contribute to scopes of work, fee proposals and tender opportunities, with an interest in supporting the development of new markets and service opportunities. A commitment to maintaining a high level of environmental assessment knowledge and professional awareness is essential, alongside a proactive approach to continuous professional development and business growth.
Qualifications & Experience
Expected
A degree in science or engineering with an environmental component.
Typically, at least five years’ relevant experience in EIA coordination, EIA project management or a related environmental assessment role.
Experience working in an environmental consultancy and/or regulatory environment.
Experience coordinating planning applications and environmental documentation.
Knowledge of relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation.
Demonstrable experience coordinating multi-disciplinary project inputs and deliverables.
Strong written, verbal, organisational and interpersonal communication skills.
Beneficial
A master’s degree in a relevant environmental discipline.
Membership of the Institution of Environmental Sciences or another relevant professional body.
Knowledge of the Habitats Directive and Appropriate Assessment processes.
Knowledge of Strategic Environmental Assessment. Experience in project budgeting, forecasting, cost control and commercial management.
Experience contributing to fee proposals, tenders and business development activity. Equivalent professional experience demonstrating the required technical and project management capabilities will also be considered.
Working Environment
This role may be based in one of Tetra Tech’s offices in Dublin, Cork, Galway, Sligo, Kilkenny. Hybrid and flexible working arrangements are available in line with Tetra Tech’s working practices and the requirements of projects and clients. Th

About The Role

This role will serve as a strategic architecture leader responsible for building secure, scalable, and compliant solutions that strengthen cyber resilience while supporting business objectives.
The ideal candidate brings a combination of security architecture expertise, ServiceNow platform knowledge, and experience designing integrated solutions for Vulnerability Response, Threat Intelligence, IAM, Zero Trust, and GRC programs. What You'll Do
Design and maintain enterprise security architecture aligned with cyber risk, compliance, and business objectives.
Architect ServiceNow Security Operations solutions, including Vulnerability Response and Threat Intelligence integrations.
Develop security data models and enterprise risk integrations that enhance visibility, reporting, and decision-making.
Design Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Zero Trust architecture patterns across enterprise applications and platforms.
Establish role-based access controls (RBAC), ACL configurations, and least-privilege security standards to protect sensitive data.
Partner with security, compliance, and risk teams to implement GRC/IRM frameworks and governance controls.
Create architecture standards, technical roadmaps, reference models, and solution design documentation.
Evaluate emerging technologies, security tools, and integration strategies to continuously improve security capabilities.
Basic Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, ServiceNow architecture, IAM, GRC, or related security disciplines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience designing and implementing security architecture solutions in enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience with Vulnerability Response, Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, or security workflow automation solutions.
Experience implementing Identity and Access Management controls, role-based access models, and least-privilege frameworks.
Knowledge of Zero Trust principles, enterprise security controls, and data protection requirements.
Experience developing architecture documentation, standards, and technical design artifacts.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills/Experience
Experience with ServiceNow Security Operations (SecOps) modules.
Experience with ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) and Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC).
Experience implementing enterprise security data models and risk integration strategies.
Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOX, HIPAA, or similar standards.
Experience integrating security platforms, vulnerability scanners, IAM tools, CMDBs, and threat intelligence feeds.
Experience supporting cloud security architectures across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

jobs.title: Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
jobs.desc:
Acorn Vets, Mallow, Co. Cork
Part-Time | Permanent
3 Days Per Week + Shared On-Call Rota
Salary from €55,000+ DOE (FTE)
Looking for a Small Animal Role That Fits Around Life?
Acorn Vets is seeking a Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and progressive team in Mallow, Co. Cork.
This is an excellent opportunity for a vet looking for a part-time position without compromising on clinical variety, professional development, or team support. Working three days per week alongside a shared on-call rota, this role offers the chance to enjoy a rewarding veterinary career while maintaining the work-life balance that matters to you.
Whether you're looking to reduce hours, return to practice, balance family commitments, or simply want a more sustainable working pattern, we would love to hear from you.
Enjoy Clinical Freedom and a Varied Caseload
You'll be responsible for consultations, medical case workups, diagnostics, surgery, and ongoing case management, working with a loyal and engaged client base that values continuity of care.
We trust our vets to make clinical decisions, manage cases appropriately, and practise medicine to a high standard. You'll have the autonomy to use your clinical judgement while working within a supportive environment where collaboration and case discussion are actively encouraged.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a vet who enjoys first-opinion practice and wants to work with a team that genuinely values quality medicine, teamwork, and professional growth.
A Supportive Team Culture
At Acorn Vets, we believe that great veterinary care starts with great teamwork.
You'll be joining a welcoming, experienced team that works closely together to provide high standards of patient and client care. We foster a supportive culture where everyone's contribution is valued and where professional development is actively encouraged.
For vets looking to pursue additional qualifications or develop particular clinical interests, certificate funding and career development support are available.
Established Practice, Modern Facilities
Acorn Vets has proudly served the pets, livestock, and farming communities of North Cork for many years. We have built a strong reputation based on high clinical standards, excellent client relationships, and genuine community involvement.
This role is based mainly within our Mallow practice, where you'll have access to modern facilities and equipment while enjoying the benefits of a close-knit practice environment. As part of the IVC Evidensia network, you'll also benefit from access to a wider clinical community, professional support, and long-term career opportunities.
Why Mallow?
Mallow offers the perfect blend of career opportunity and lifestyle.
Located in the heart of North Cork, the town provides excellent access to Cork City while offering a more relaxed pace of life, affordable living, and beautiful countryside on your doorstep. Whether you're already based in Cork or considering a move to the region, Mallow offers an excellent quality of life alongside a fulfilling veterinary career.
About You
We are looking for a veterinary surgeon who is passionate about companion animal practice and committed to delivering excellent patient care.
Applicants must be registered, or eligible to register, with the Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI).
You should be confident managing routine consultations, medical cases, and surgery within a first-opinion setting. Strong communication skills, a proactive approach, and a desire to work as part of a collaborative team are essential.
We are open to applications from vets with varying levels of experience and are particularly keen to hear from candidates seeking a flexible part-time opportunity within an established and supportive practice.
About You
We are keen to hear from veterinary surgeons who enjoy the variety and challenges of mixed practice and who value working as part of a supportive team.
Applicants must be registered, or eligible to register, with the Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI). Previous experience in mixed practice is desirable, although we are open to considering candidates with strong experience in either farm animal or companion animal practice who are keen to maintain and develop mixed practice skills.
Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, adaptable, client-focused, and committed to delivering excellent clinical care.
A Benefits Package That Supports You
Alongside a competitive salary, you’ll benefit from a package designed to support both your professional growth and personal wellbeing including:
Work Life Balance  & Employee Wellbeing
22 days Annual Leave  & Birthday leave
Paid Maternity, Paternity & Adoptive Leave Packages
Cycle to Work Scheme
Full access to EAP and Wellbeing Centre
Paid Bereavement Leave  & Company Sick Pay
Development
€1300 annual CPD allowance with 5 days paid CPD days pro rata
Funding of any Certificates / Diplomas / PhD’s you may want to pursue
Career Progression Opportunities, both clinical and non-clinical
Professional Memberships
VCI membership paid
VDS cover paid
Additional Benefits
Annual Pay Reviews
Dedicated CARE fund - annual contribution of €1,100 from IVC Evidensia for each Vet to use on a case of your choice to ensure successful outcome with your patient (T&C’s apply)
Pawesome Benefits - reward gateway giving discounts and cashback with hundreds of retailers
Employer Pension Contributions
Free Flu Inoculations
Discounted Veterinary Fees
Opportunity to join company programmes (LGBTQ+, Wellbeing Champions, Nurses Committee, Clinical Board and many more)
Build a Career That Works for You
If you're looking for a part-time veterinary role that combines clinical autonomy, a supportive team environment, genuine career development opportunities, and the lifestyle benefits of living in Cork, Acorn Vets could be the perfect fit.
Join a practice where your expertise is valued, your development is supported, and your contribution makes a real difference every day.

Flexible working hours
Sports & Social clubs and DE&I Employee Resource Groups

Currently completing an Irish or Northern Irish university qualification in Engineering courses including:
Mechanical Engineering

jobs.desc:
Description
JOB TITLE: Quality Technician (24 month FTC)
DEPARTMENT:
Quality Department
REPORTING TO:
Quality Operations Lead
Please note that this is a shift-based position (12-hour shifts which include days and nights inclusive of weekends). A competitive basic salary + shift allowances and benefits package provide!
About Sanmina Fermoy
Our Fermoy, Ireland, facility is FDA registered and certified to ISO ISO13485:2016 for the manufacture of high-quality PCBAs, subassemblies and complete devices up to and including Class III medical devices.
Sanmina Fermoy’s core specialization is manufacturing automation. We provide services for the entire product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI), prototyping and process validation to complex volume manufacturing & test, shipping and repair. We create a state-of-the-art environment for manufacturing medical and other high-quality devices. The facility has a track record of 30 years of outstanding operational performance and customer service, backed by a highly experienced workforce.
We hire people with a range of skills, experience, and backgrounds to fulfill roles in careers such as engineering, quality and manufacturing to name just a few.
Objectives Of Position
To ensure customer satisfaction by monitoring, controlling and improving all related customer processes. Customer interface for Quality metrics and improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities
Support quality process definition, set up, verification and improvements.
Complete in-process testing on Product.
Complete weekly leak & burst testing on product to ensure product is sealed correctly as per the required specification.
Verification of the Critical process parameters (CPP`s) & Line Clearance activities.
Conducting internal process audits to ensure conformance and effectiveness of the Quality System.
Supporting Audits by demonstrating product testing requirements & best practices.
Feedback and improvement on Customer ‘Supplier Quality Issues’.
Prepare for and attend daily engagement process meetings.
Identify improvements through Quality review and meetings on Quality, Yield, flow, documentation, control etc.
Escalation of Quality Issues where necessary & conduct non-conformance investigations when required.
Perform weekly environmental monitoring sampling of the ISO Class 8 Cleanrooms.
Prepare and review sterile release packs (Endotoxin & Bioburden test reports).
Conducting & verifying releasing of sterile product.
Supporting SMT line first off verifications along with verifying line clearance activities.
Reviewing & approving unplanned maintenance activities when required across multiple assembly lines.
Determine Lot suitability for release by reviewing production logs and final batch records against product specifications, procedures and electronic data systems.
Review and approval of Design History Records (DHR) by obtaining and verifying the contents of DHR’s against the relevant documentation requirements.
Interacting with manufacturing execution system (MES) & Oracle Agile systems daily to ensure products are assembled as per the required specification.
Work space compliance to Site requirements, ESD, MSD, Housekeeping (5S), Safety etc.
Assure ongoing compliance with quality and industry regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with Health & Safety Legislation and Regulations.
Measurements
Yields at Key Process Steps (“Critical Quality Attribute” Stations).
Accuracy and consistency of record collection.
Adherence to GDP & GMP practices.
Completion of tasks/projects against set objectives in performance review
Essential
PERSONNEL SPECIFICATIONS:
Minimum NFQ Level 6 Certificate / Diploma in Science or Engineering, or sufficient job-related experience.
Sound understanding and utilization of problem-solving techniques
Proficient in the use of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Good communication and influencing skills.
Ability to write standard operating procedures and training documents.
Desirable
Experience in a similar Quality role in the electronics manufacturing industry.
Experience in working within a Medical Device Manufacturing Environment.
Six sigma Green or Black Belt certified.
Experience in New Product Introduction Processes.

About Bauer Media Audio Ireland
Bauer Media Audio Ireland is the country’s largest commercial radio group with eight radio stations including the national stations Today FM and Newstalk, two SPIN youth stations in Dublin and the Southwest of Ireland, iRadio across the Northeast and Northwest, 98FM in Dublin, Beat in the Southeast and Red FM in Cork.
We also operate Ireland’s leading digital sports brand Off the Ball, the aggregated listening platform GoLoud for radio, podcasts and music, audioXi, Ireland’s largest digital audio advertising exchange and Media Central, the leading media sales house in Ireland.
Red FM is Cork's number one commercial radio station, delivering a mix of hit music, local news, entertainment and community-focused programming. As part of Bauer Media Audio Ireland, Red FM has a strong local identity while benefiting from the scale of Ireland's largest commercial radio group.
Audience: 165,000 weekly listeners, with a 21.2% market share in Cork, making it the most-listened-to station in the county.
Flagship shows: Red FM Breakfast with KC, The Neil Prendeville Show, and Home Run with Colm O'Sullivan.
Focus: Cork-first content, live events, local partnerships, and entertainment that reflects the city's culture and community.
About The Role
Join Red FM as a key part of our Events and Marketing team, representing some of the country’s most recognisable radio and digital audio brands. This is a dynamic, hands-on role where no two days are the same—you’ll be out in the field bringing our brands to life through live events, promotions, and engaging activations.
As a Red Patroller, you’ll play an important role in delivering memorable audience experiences, supporting event execution from start to finish, and ensuring our partners and clients are represented to the highest standard. You’ll interact directly with the public, create engaging social content, and contribute valuable feedback to help shape future campaigns.
This role suits someone energetic, personable, and passionate about media, marketing, and live events. It also offers the opportunity to develop practical experience across event operations, brand promotion, and digital content creation, while working closely with a collaborative and fast-paced team. Flexible availability, including evenings and weekends, is essential due to the nature of live events.
What You’ll Do
Be the face of our brands at live events, promotions, and activations
Support the Events & Marketing teams in delivering engaging, high-quality experiences
Execute client briefs and ensure all brand elements are represented professionally and creatively
Assist with set-up, execution, and breakdown of events
Engage with the public and encourage interaction with our stations
Capture on-site content for social media and campaign reporting
Provide insights and feedback from events to help improve future activations
Carry out ad hoc promotional or operational tasks during other shifts as required
Selected candidates may be required to perform duties outside their primary job responsibilities as needed to support team and organizational goals.
Who You Are
Outgoing, energetic, and confident in engaging with the public
A team player who brings positivity and initiative to every event
Skilled communicator with strong customer service instincts
Passionate about live events, brand marketing, and media
Social media savvy, with an eye for what makes engaging content
Comfortable working flexible hours, including evenings and weekends
What You’ll Have:
A full, clean driver’s license held for at least 2 years.
Experience or a strong interest in events, broadcasting, media, or marketing
Please note: Due to company vehicle insurance requirements, applicants must be eligible to drive company vehicles under our insurance policy. Currently, this policy applies to drivers aged 21 and over.
Working Days:
Varied and flexible hours across Monday to Sunday depending on event schedules

11th of November 2026

About the Company
Cork City Council invites applications, on the official application form, from suitably qualified persons, who wish to be considered for inclusion on a panel from which temporary and permanent vacancies for the post of Executive Engineer may be filled.
About the Role
Executive Engineers are appointed to a wide variety of roles across the Council. The role can include responsibility for the management and successful delivery of a range of projects, staff supervision, budget oversight, and public engagement. You will be involved in all stages of project planning and execution, from design to completion, while ensuring compliance with health and safety legislation and delivering high-quality outcomes for the community. In addition to technical expertise, the role demands strong communication and leadership skills, as you will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including elected officials, community groups, and contractors. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on Cork City’s development while working in a supportive and collaborative environment. The person/s appointed will report to and work under the direction of the Senior Engineer or Senior Executive Engineer or other officer designated by the Director of Services or the Chief Executive.
Responsibilities
Supervising, managing and carrying out engineering/ancillary services to include the preparation and management of work programmes.
Supporting all aspects of the delivery of projects including, the development of the project brief, managing design/planning/procurement processes, construction supervision, programme management, quality management, dispute resolution and financial management as required in accordance with best practice project management, contract management and financial management procedures.
Management of Consultants and Contractors including procurement.
Administering construction works contracts including discharging the duties of Employers Representative where required.
Managing staff performance, conduct and development and associated industrial relations issues as required.
Preparing budgets, ensuring that works are implemented within allocated budgets and ensuring accurate and timely draw-down of scheme funds from funding agencies.
Maintaining and proactively developing a culture of Health and Safety in the workplace while ensuring compliance with Health & Safety legislation and regulations.
Ensuring that the responsibilities of the Project Supervisor Construction Stage (PSCS), Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP) are discharged across capital projects in line with the Council’s Corporate Health & Safety systems.
Dealing with representations from Elected Members and community organisations.
Representing the City Council at meetings with, elected members, community/general interest groups, businesses, and residents. Prepare reports for meetings, as required.
Managing public consultation and engagement processes including liaison with the public and other key stakeholders.
Keeping precise and detailed records in both paper, electronic and map-based formats for all work, including updating of GIS systems.
Working effectively with the Elected Members and staff in all Council Directorates towards the successful delivery of Services.
Liaising with other local authorities, government departments and statutory agencies.
Working with senior management in devising and implementing strategies leading to improved efficiencies in delivery of services.
Qualifications
Education, Training, Experience, etc.

d) possess a high standard of administrative experience.
e) Have a satisfactory knowledge of public service organisation or the ability to acquire such knowledge.

jobs.title: Group Application Owner (Revit - Full Lifecycle Support)
jobs.desc:
Overview
The Revit Group Application Owner is the global leader for Autodesk Revit across PM Group’s project delivery lifecycle, shaping how digital design is delivered at scale. This strategic role embeds governance, drives innovation, standardisation, and continuous improvement, ensuring Revit enables high-performance, data-driven collaboration while advancing PM Group’s BIM, digital engineering, and project delivery ambitions.
Who We Are
PM Group is an employee owned, international project delivery firm with a team of 3,000+ people. We are world leaders in the pharma, food, medtech and mission critical sectors. From our network of offices in Europe, Asia and the US, we work with the world's leading organisations. We are focused on growing a sustainable business centred on our people, our clients and trade partners.
Responsibilities
Global Design Applications Leadership & Governance
Act as PM Group Expert for the Revit product, driving innovation and continuous improvement in project delivery.
Own and maintain the Global Revit Template, libraries, discipline-specific families, and shared parameter standards.
Govern Revit configuration, view templates, sheet standards, and modelling conventions to support all disciplines.
Maintain ownership of Revit application health, performance, configuration, standards, release readiness, issue trends, and optimisation priorities.
Ensure alignment with Group BIM Standards, model QA protocols, and ISO 19650 principles.
Support version control procedures, release testing, deployment readiness, and controlled rollout of new Revit releases and updates.
Ensure Revit and associated plug-ins, add-ins, and integrations comply with PM Group IT and Security standards prior to approval and deployment.
Determine and communicate latest minimum and optimal hardware requirements.
Model Coordination & Lifecycle Enablement
Enable cross-discipline model coordination, ensuring Revit output integrates cleanly with Navisworks, Plant 3D, and downstream tools.
Manage technical escalations with Autodesk for significant Revit application and project issues, ensuring appropriate investigation, resolution, and communication across affected project teams.
Enable full lifecycle data continuity by validating shared parameters, metadata structures, tagging conventions, and schedule data.
Collaborate with Construction, Process, and CQV teams to ensure Revit data supports 4D, sequencing, installation workflows, asset tagging, and commissioning handover requirements. Support CDE workflows and ensure consistent Revit-to-Forma integration.
Application Support & Productivity Enablement
Work with Application Support Technicians to coordinate resolution of user issues, performance problems, family errors, and modelling inconsistencies, ensuring recurring issues are captured and addressed through standards, configuration, support training, or improvement actions.
Create a competency test for potential hires and score it on behalf of the recruiting manager.
Review, test, and validate new plug-ins, add-ins, and integrations prior to deployment, including discipline automation tools.
Develop productivity improvements such as Dynamo scripts, parametric families, and automation workflows that reduce rework and manual effort with the Digital Technologist team.
Provide specialist guidance to Digital Technologists, BIM Coordinators, and project teams across all regions.
Training, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Develop and contribute to Revit training materials, onboarding resources, best-practice guides, and full-lifecycle workflows.
Deliver training sessions and knowledge-sharing workshops aligned with global standards.
Gather feedback from users and project teams to identify opportunities for enhancement,standardisation, or configuration changes.
Run Revit Clinics for BIM Principal Designers.
Report adoption trends, shared challenges, risks, and improvement opportunities to the Group BIM Programme Manager.
Act as product SME for assigned applications, maintaining awareness of vendor roadmaps, emerging features, automation opportunities, and future capability improvements.
Qualifications
7+ years’ experience in Revit modelling, coordination, and multi-discipline project delivery, preferably across Architecture, MEP, Structural, and Process.
Strong understanding of families, worksharing, templates, and Revit-to-ACC workflows.
Experience supporting coordinated model delivery for Construction, Design, or CQV teams is an advantage.
Knowledge of ISO 19650, model QA processes, CDE workflows, and federated model structures. Experience with Dynamo or Python scripting is beneficial.
Effective communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Demonstrable experience in enabling and delivering innovation.
Excellent communication skills and ability to support global teams.
Success Measures
Measurable improvement in global adoption of approved Revit templates, families, and workflows. Reduction in recurring model, drawing, family, and configuration issues across disciplines.
Improved project start-up efficiency through controlled standards, templates, and deployment readiness. Improved application reliability, performance, and readiness through proactive monitoring of issue trends, configuration quality, and release impacts.
Evidence of alignment with ISO 19650 principles, Group BIM Standards, and digital delivery frameworks through QA reviews and governance checks.
Positive feedback from project teams, BIM Coordinators, and discipline leads.
Why PM Group?
As an employee-owned company, we are inclusive, committed and driven. Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability are the heart of our new 2025 business strategy. Click
here
to read more in our
Corporate Responsibility & Health and Safety Report 2020.
Inclusion and Diversity are core to our culture and values. Wherever we work, we commit to a culture of mutual respect and belonging by building a truly inclusive workplace rich in diverse people, talents and ideas. Valuing the contributions of all our people and respecting individual differences will sustain our growth into the future.

Familiarity with Boots products and services.

colleagues stories here.

Generous employee discount (After 1 month’s service)
Access to our One Hub discount platform

boots.jobs/ireland

jobs.title: SAP O2C Functional Architect
jobs.desc:
Your career at Deutsche Börse Group
Your Area of Work:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Architect, with mandatory SAP SD certification and strong integration expertise across FI and Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), to join our Corporate IT team in Cork.
A key success factor for this role is strong end-to-end integration expertise, particularly with Salesforce (CRM) and Workday (Finance/HR platforms), ensuring seamless O2C processes across the enterprise landscape.
Corporate IT is the enterprise IT backbone of Deutsche Börse Group, supporting global business functions and delivering critical platforms including customer and vendor master data, financial systems, and data warehouses. This role sits at the intersection of business architecture, SAP S/4HANA transformation, and cloud integration, with a strong emphasis on billing, revenue recognition, and compliance-driven financial processes within Financial Services.
As a Functional Architect, you will lead the design and evolution of end-to-end O2C processes in S/4HANA, ensuring seamless integration across Sales & Distribution (SD), Finance (FI), Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), and external platforms such as Salesforce and Workday to support compliant and automated revenue recognition aligned with IFRS standards.
You will also support our hybrid cloud strategy using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), enabling modern integration and extensibility patterns.
Your Responsibilities:
Solution Architecture & Design
Own and lead the end-to-end SAP O2C architecture, covering SD, FI, and RAR integration within S/4HANA.
Define and govern integration architecture across SAP, Salesforce (Lead/Opportunity to Order), and Workday (financial processing and reporting).
Design scalable solutions for billing, invoicing, contract-based revenue, and event-based revenue recognition.
Define architectural patterns for integrating SD billing outputs into RAR, including performance obligations (POBs) and revenue allocation.
Ensure alignment with IFRS 15 / ASC 606 compliance requirements through robust RAR design.
Business Engagement & Process Design
Lead requirements gathering and design workshops with Finance, Billing, Customer Operations, and CRM stakeholders.
Drive end-to-end process design across: Lead → Opportunity (Salesforce) → Order (SAP SD) → Billing → Revenue Recognition → Financial Posting (FI / Workday)
Translate complex business requirements into standard SAP solutions leveraging SD, FI, and RAR capabilities, supported by robust cross-system integrations.
Identify opportunities for process harmonization and automation across the O2C lifecycle.
Implementation & Integration
Oversee and guide SAP SD configuration and billing processes, ensuring optimal integration into FI, RAR, and external platforms.
Design and implement:
SD → FI integration (account determination, AR posting, tax handling)
SD → RAR integration (revenue contracts, fulfillment events, contract modifications)
RAR → FI integration (revenue postings, deferred revenue, adjustments)
Salesforce → SAP integration (opportunity, contract, and order orchestration)
SAP → Workday integration (financial postings, reconciliation, reporting alignment)
Ensure scalable API-first and event-driven integration patterns leveraging SAP BTP Integration Suite.
Guide development teams on enhancements, APIs, middleware, and BTP-based integrations supporting O2C and RAR.
Agile Delivery & Innovation
Participate in and lead agile delivery teams, focusing on incremental value delivery in O2C and revenue processes.
Champion modern integration patterns (API-driven, event-based, cloud-native) across SAP, Salesforce, and Workday ecosystems.
Contribute to architecture standards, reusable templates, and design governance.
Operations & Collaboration
Collaborate across Cork, Frankfurt, and Luxembourg teams to deliver and support O2C and revenue solutions.
Work closely with Salesforce and Workday stakeholders to ensure data consistency and process alignment.
Provide expert-level support and troubleshooting for billing, integration, and revenue recognition issues.
Ensure data integrity, reconciliation, and audit readiness across SD, FI, RAR, and integrated systems.
Your Profile:
Core Requirements
SAP Certified in SD (mandatory).
Strong expertise in FI integration (SAP FI certification nice to have).
Proven hands-on experience or certification in SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
Strong hands-on experience integrating SAP with Salesforce and Workday (mandatory).
8+ years of SAP experience, including significant exposure to O2C and revenue recognition processes.
Experience as a Functional Lead or Solution Architect in S/4HANA implementations or transformations.
Functional & Technical Expertise
Deep expertise in:
SAP SD (Order Management, Pricing, Billing)
FI integration (AR, GL, revenue postings, account determination)
RAR (Revenue Accounting and Reporting)
Strong understanding of integration flows across: Salesforce → SAP SD → RAR → FI / Workday
Proven experience with:
Salesforce integration (Sales Cloud, CPQ, opportunity lifecycle)
Workday integration (financials, accounting interfaces, reporting)
APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures
Experience with:
Contract-based and usage-based billing scenarios
Complex revenue scenarios in regulated or financial environments
Solid knowledge of:
Master Data (Business Partner, Customer, Material)
Cross-system integration and data synchronization
SAP BTP Integration Suite and extensibility frameworks
Working knowledge of ABAP and extensibility frameworks (BADIs, APIs).
Professional Skills
Strong architecture and solution design mindset, with focus on scalability, compliance, and performance.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across Finance, IT, and CRM domains.
Proven ability to bridge business and technical domains, especially across SAP, Salesforce, and Workday ecosystems.
Experience with agile (Scrum) and hybrid delivery models (JIRA, GitHub desirable).
High degree of analytical thinking, ownership, and ability to work independently.
Additional Assets
Experience in Financial Services or other regulated industries.
Exposure to IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition frameworks.
Experience with SAP BRIM, subscription or usage-based billing models.
SAP FI certification (nice to have).
German and/or French language skills are a plus.

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Midleton (25 - 30 hours)
jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.

Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
