jobs.desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
The Energy Business Unit
The Energy Business Unit develops cutting-edge sensing and algorithmic solutions for modern electrical infrastructure. We focus on transforming raw data from distribution grid assets into actionable intelligence to enable a more reliable, efficient, and resilient power system, accelerating global goals of decarbonization and low-cost energy for everyone.
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced algorithm engineer and leader (Principal Engineer) to help shape and execute on next-generation grid intelligence solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with a clear pathway toward broader leadership responsibilities.
The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of power systems with advanced expertise in signal processing and machine learning, has experience across an entire algorithm development and deployment pipeline, from first idea and proof-of-concept through to deployment across complex distributed systems, and is an excellent communicator capable of bridging the gaps between stakeholders at multiple organization levels and of varied backgrounds.
What You’ll Do
Own and drive the design and development of advanced algorithms for power system monitoring and grid analytics (e.g., transformers, asset health, and condition monitoring)
Develop signal processing and machine learning techniques to extract actionable insights from real-world sensor data.
Architect and deploy solutions across the Edge-to-Cloud stack, including implementation on resource-constrained and embedded platforms
Lead end-to-end solution development, from modelling and simulation through to validation and production deployment.
Influence product and technology strategy through deep domain expertise and technical leadership.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, firmware, data, applications) to translate innovations into scalable products
Engage with grid equipment OEMS, utilities, industry partners, and stakeholders to ensure solutions address real-world challenges
Mentor engineers and contribute to building a high-performance team, with opportunity to grow into broader leadership roles
What You’ll Bring
Strong background in Power Systems Engineering, including modelling of grid assets (e.g. transformers, distribution systems)
Deep expertise in Signal Processing and Machine Learning, with proven application to real-world data
Experience deploying solutions across Edge and Cloud architectures, particularly in constrained or embedded environments
Excellent communication skills and ability to influence and reason across technical and non-technical stakeholders and requirements
Proven ability to translate models and algorithms into production systems
Strong programming and modelling experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or embedded environments)
Experience working with sensor data and physical system modelling (digital twins)
Required Experience
A Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Power Systems, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (equivalent experience will be accepted)
A minimum of 6 years’ experience post-PhD (12 years post bachelors degree) with development and deployment experience of practical algorithms in production systems,
Leadership skills, as proven by a record of increasing responsibility in technical leadership and management
Communication skills, as proven by a record of technical talks and influence in a technical field,
Innovation skills, as proven by a record of patents and/or technical publications demonstrating novelty and the ability to think creatively.
Preferred Experience
Condition monitoring or predictive maintenance in energy systems
Industrial IoT, distributed sensing, or grid analytics platforms
Demonstrated experience scaling prototypes into production deployments
Demonstrated early leadership experience or strong motivation to grow into leadership
Availability to travel to customers and partners (10% of time)
Why Join ADI
Join ADI’s Energy Business Unit and contribute to building intelligent systems that enable the transition to a more resilient and sustainable power grid. You will work at the intersection of advanced sensing, algorithms, and real-world infrastructure, delivering solutions with tangible global impact.

jobs.title: Java Engineer, Radar Engineering
jobs.desc:
Summary
Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by
every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As
Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career Java Engineer to help build and scale the services behind Radar.
Description
As a Java Engineer on the Radar Platform team, you will help build and run the services
behind Radar, Apple’s platform for product development, bug tracking, and work management. Radar is a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple, and the work you do here will be felt by engineers company-wide from your first release.
You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly
collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver
end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured
mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to
learn and develop your skills quickly.
You will write, test, and ship Java code across a complex microservices ecosystem built on
Spring, Solr, and Oracle. You will build new features, fix bugs, and learn how a platform at this
scale remains stable while constantly evolving. As you ramp up, you will take on increasing
ownership of features and services, contribute to design discussions, and help bring new
technologies onto the platform.
Responsibilities
Design, build, and test features and bug fixes for Radar’s backend services in Java.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and participate in code reviews.
Work with senior engineers to break down features into well-scoped tasks and deliver them on schedule.
Investigate and resolve production issues alongside the team and our Ops partners.
Contribute to technical design discussions and documentation.
Follow and help improve the team’s engineering best practices.
Minimum Qualifications
Solid programming skills in Java or similar language, with a good grasp of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with version control (Git) and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.
Experience building REST APIs or backend services, for example with Spring.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with Redis, Solr, Kafka, and Oracle.
Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
Experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit.
Interest or experience in agentic workflows, MCP integrations, or AI-assisted development tools.
Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution.

The Team and the opportunity
Ireland’s energy and utilities sector is facing unprecedented change as it transforms to meet global sustainability challenges and ambitions objectives set out by government. EY are supporting our clients to meet these challenges head on to plan for and deliver a resilient and sustainable future.
EY believes a better working world means addressing big, complex issues to deliver outcomes that grow, optimise and protect our clients' businesses. The world is constantly changing, creating abundant opportunities and essential risks for government, public and private sector organisations. In Transformation Architecture, we help our clients see their future and define their purpose, and then we design, lead and deliver the end-to-end transformations to realise this ambition.
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too.
Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
This is a leadership role, and you will be part of a talented team who will work closely with you to bring the best of EY’s sustainability offering to the energy and utilities sector and to the wider business community.
Our Energy and Utilities teams work with high profile clients across the sector on the island of Ireland and internationally to solve their most complex issues. This is the perfect time to join a growing team and to make your mark across a wide variety of markets, sectors and industries.
You will develop relationships with our key accounts in line with our Go to Market priorities. You will be client facing, scoping solutions based on client need and working in diverse teams to solve clients’ most complex of problems. Most of your time will be spent embedded with our clients as you drive the best of our portfolio to market.
You will be commercially focused, experienced at developing business, and comfortable operating at scale. You will be part of the decision-making around leveraging key accounts, growing the Competency and developing our talented team.

Lead, manage and empower multi-disciplinary teams.
Be experienced in creating impactful thought leadership for use in business development, engagement delivery, as well as marketing to build EY’s profile in the energy sector.

Between 10-12 years within the energy sector in Ireland or abroad either in the industry or with a blue-chip consulting firm (strong track record in consulting is highly desirable).
You will be experienced in delivering in complex projects in the energy market in Ireland or abroad.
A proven track record in delivering a suite of strategic and business transformation in the energy sector.
Senior stakeholder management (e.g. Board, C-Suite) and communication experience.

jobs.title: Quality Analyst / Quality Improvement Analyst
jobs.desc:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
At Jacobs, quality is about far more than compliance. It's about helping deliver better outcomes for our clients, our projects and our communities.
As a Quality Analyst / Quality Improvement Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of major rail and highways infrastructure programmes across Ireland. Working alongside experienced quality and project teams, you'll help improve processes, strengthen governance, identify opportunities for innovation and support continuous improvement initiatives that drive business performance.
This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious early-career professional looking to build a career in quality, business improvement, digital transformation and operational excellence. You'll gain exposure to complex infrastructure projects while developing valuable skills in quality management, process improvement, data analytics, automation and AI-enabled ways of working.
About The Opportunity
You'll support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality management processes across our Transportation business, contributing to some of Ireland's most significant rail and highways projects. Working closely with operational teams and business leaders, you'll help identify efficiencies, improve ways of working and support quality assurance activities that enhance project delivery.
What You'll Be Doing
Supporting quality assurance and continuous improvement programmes across the business.
Assisting with process mapping, workflow analysis and business improvement initiatives.
Analysing data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
Producing reports, dashboards and quality performance metrics.
Supporting internal audits, compliance reviews and governance activities.
Assisting with root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
Identifying opportunities to leverage automation, AI and digital tools to improve efficiency.
Supporting the implementation of process improvements and change initiatives.
Maintaining quality management systems, processes and documentation.
Here's what you'll need
We're looking for someone who is curious, analytical and passionate about making things work better.
You'll likely have
A degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business, Data Analytics, Project Management or a related discipline.
Experience within quality, business improvement, engineering, project support or a related field.
An understanding of quality management and continuous improvement principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience using Excel, Power BI or similar reporting tools.
An interest in AI, automation and digital transformation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ideally, You'll Also Have
Experience supporting internal audit activities.
CQI membership or a desire to work towards Chartered Quality Professional status.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management standards.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience using process mapping or workflow analysis tools.
Awareness of Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI or Microsoft Copilot solutions
Why Jacobs?
At Jacobs, you'll be part of a collaborative team helping to shape the future of infrastructure delivery. This role offers hands-on experience across quality, business improvement, governance, automation and digital transformation, providing an excellent platform for professional growth and long-term career development.
Whether you're looking to deepen your quality expertise, build your analytical capabilities or develop skills in emerging technologies, we'll help you grow your career while contributing to projects that create lasting positive impact across Ireland.
Benefits for Ireland Employees
At Jacobs, we put people first and provide benefits that support your wellbeing, career development and work-life balance, including
Hybrid and flexible working arrangements
Professional membership reimbursement
Industry-leading learning and development programmes
Career progression opportunities across Ireland, the UK and globally
Employee assistance programme
Annual leave with the opportunity to purchase additional days
Pension scheme
Life assurance
Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives
Inclusive culture that values diversity, belonging and individual growth
Apply today and help us deliver smarter, more efficient and higher-quality outcomes across Ireland's most important infrastructure programmes
Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.
With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.
We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.
Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.
As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.title: Summer Intern - Electrical Engineer APM
jobs.desc:
Application Closing Date: 6th November 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged.
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
Role description:
Our paid Intern & Placement programme is designed to give you a hands-on insight into the work we do as a company and help to develop skills and knowledge within your chosen field. Supported by signposted training, the programme is based on Arcadis’ core values, giving you both technical training and support to help you develop both personally and professionally whilst with us. You will be exposed to real projects and clients and given a range of experiences to immerse yourself into over the course of your 10–12-week internship or 12-month placement.
Role accountabilities:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Summer Intern Electrical Engineer to join our growing Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience on innovative projects within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and industrial sectors while working alongside experienced engineers and project managers.
As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will support the design and delivery of complex engineering projects, gaining exposure to electrical power systems, instrumentation design, commissioning, and construction support activities. This internship will provide valuable insight into the role of an Electrical Engineer and help you develop both your technical and professional skills.
What You'll Do
As a Summer Intern Electrical Engineer, you will:
Support the design of electrical power distribution systems and building services.
Assist in producing electrical drawings, schematics, and single-line diagrams.
Contribute to electrical design calculations, including cable sizing, voltage drop, lighting studies, and load assessments.
Gain experience in short-circuit, protection coordination, and arc flash studies.
Support the development of utility service matrices and engineering databases.
Assist with preparing technical specifications, reports, and project documentation.
Take part in site surveys, inspections, testing, and commissioning activities.
Work closely with process, mechanical, HVAC, architectural, construction, and validation teams.
Learn and apply industry standards, engineering principles, and best practices.
Our Summer Internship Programme provides the opportunity to gain practical engineering experience while working on world-class pharmaceutical, life sciences, and industrial projects. You will receive support and mentorship from experienced engineering professionals, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and gain valuable exposure to both office-based and site-based activities. The programme offers an inclusive and supportive environment where you can develop your technical skills, build your professional network, and gain insight into future career opportunities within our growing engineering team.
Accepted Degrees: Electrical Engineering or related discipline
Qualifications & Experience:
You will be working towards a degree in a relevant subject
You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player
You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders.
Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working)
Why Arcadis?
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success.

jobs.title: AI Governance Specialist
jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
AI Governance Specialist
Contract Type:
Fixed-term contract until July 2027
Working Pattern:
Full-time
Logitech is hiring an AI Governance Specialist on a fixed-term contract to help us develop our global AI Governance program and run AI Governance operations, enabling responsible AI adoption while managing regulatory and operational risks.
This is an exciting global role on our legal team which covers all of Logitech's functional teams and business groups such as Gaming, Hardware, Software, and Logitech for Business.
This person will play a key role in delivering operational aspects of Logitech's AI governance program, including ensuring both our internal use of AI and use of AI in our products remain in compliance with our policies, standards and procedures. They will provide practical guidance on AI use, challenge incomplete information, and lead a defined set of projects.
This role reports to the AI Governance Manager. This is a hybrid role, with 2 days a week on site in Cork.
Your Contribution
Be yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Do.
These are the behaviours you'll need to be successful at Logitech. In this role, you will lead or support the following projects and ongoing activities:
AI Inventory: Review and improve the completeness and accuracy of the global AI Inventory and identify gaps with business owners and engineering teams. Update the related procedure and documentation.
AI risk assessment and remediation: Work with business teams on AI risk assessments, helping system owners complete their assessments, address identified risks, and put in place the required documentation and controls. Track mitigation actions through to completion and challenge gaps in supporting evidence.
AI content labelling: Help coordinate the roll-out of Logitech's AI content labelling requirements across the business, including supporting Design Guidelines, training, and technical controls in tools and onboarding.
AI vendor reviews: Evaluate new AI vendor submissions, manage the review queue to meet our approval targets, challenge business units where information is missing, critically assess vendor responses and identify potential risks, and track completion of agreed risk treatment plans.
Project management: Drive further AI Governance projects and priorities as agreed, managing timelines, stakeholders and deliverables across multiple teams and time zones, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.
Knowledge sharing: Provide pragmatic advice to product and business teams, respond to day-to-day AI governance queries on approved enterprise tools, public AI tools and product-specific AI use, contribute to training materials, and support our AI Champions network.
Key Qualifications
Undergraduate qualification in Law, Business, Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in AI governance, privacy, compliance, risk, or a technology-focused legal role.
Working knowledge of the EU AI Act and AI governance best practices, including the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical controls and guidance.
Project management experience, including the ability to deliver multiple workstreams to deadlines and drive cross-functional action.
Technical aptitude including comfortable reading technical and vendor documentation and asking engineers and product teams clear, probing questions about how AI systems work.
Strong critical thinking, with the ability to spot omissions in proposals and challenge business units for clarity, including identifying gaps in vendor evidence and assessing residual risks.
Excellent communication skills, including translating legal concepts for technical teams and preparing training materials for non-specialist colleagues.
A self-starter who can work independently, learn quickly and be effective with minimal onboarding.
Preferred
Technical skills to automate manual governance tasks (for example scripting, workflow automation, dashboards or reminders), reducing repetitive work for the team.
Knowledge of privacy and data protection (e.g. GDPR), copyright or intellectual property.
Experience with AI inventories, impact assessments, mitigation tracking or governance process improvement.
Availability to start at short notice.
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Job Code:

Help deliver essential water and wastewater infrastructure from concept through to commissioning.
Ward & Burke is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join our expanding team based in Charleville. You will work across water and wastewater projects and take an active role throughout the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction support, commissioning and handover.
This is a hands-on engineering role offering a blend of office-based design, site surveys, technical coordination, and project delivery.
Candidate Specification
A degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
2-3 years’ experience in a similar electrical engineering or project-delivery role.
A practical understanding of LV electrical systems, motor control, control systems and instrumentation.
The ability to read and review electrical drawings, schematics, P&IDs and technical documentation.
A strong safety mindset, attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work with clients, suppliers and multidisciplinary project teams.
A willingness to travel to project sites throughout Ireland.
Responsibilities
Design and specify LV electrical and control systems for new and existing water and wastewater treatment plants, pumping stations, upgrades and expansions.
Prepare load schedules, equipment schedules, control philosophies, system architecture, electrical layouts, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, commissioning plans, and technical specifications.
Complete cable-sizing calculations and review electrical schematics, P&IDs and wiring diagrams to support system integration and troubleshooting.
Coordinate with process, mechanical and civil engineers to develop integrated, buildable project solutions.
Prepare technical submissions, respond to client review comments and support the approval process.
Carry out site surveys and assess existing electrical installations and equipment.
Support the sourcing and procurement of electrical equipment and specialist packages.
Provide technical support during installation and commissioning of electrical panels, motors, MCCs, VSDs, lighting, control and instrumentation systems.
What Ward & Burke Can Offer
The opportunity to work on essential infrastructure projects from concept through to completion.
A varied role combining design, site experience, commissioning and project delivery.
A competitive salary.
Training and support for continued professional development.
The opportunity to broaden your experience across electrical, control, instrumentation and multidisciplinary engineering.
A clear opportunity to take ownership, develop your career and grow with the business.

jobs.title: FY27 Intern Opportunities
jobs.desc:
Are you a problem solver looking for a hands-on internship position with a market-leading company that will help develop your career and reward you intellectually and professionally?
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.
ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.
At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.
Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.
Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland
Are you looking to work for a company that is a leader in technology that makes the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener? If so, then Analog Devices International is the destination for you
Leading Edge Technology;
From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality. This helped prevent 33 million metric tons of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital x-ray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world.
We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it
; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be
Ahead of What’s Possible
.
Silicon Meets Software;
Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability, we’re also focussed on building expertise in Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.
One Company, Unlimited Opportunity;
The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.
What's the secret to our success? It's very simple – we treat our employees as our greatest asset.
Role Description
Analog Devices offers full-time paid placement opportunities to 70+ students each year across a wide range of functions and disciplines. As a placement student, you will have the opportunity to work with our talented teams of engineers on very challenging work assignments. You will play an integral part in the development of our products.
To be eligible for the placement program, you must be currently enrolled in 3rd level education. We hire predominantly from Electronics, Software, and Computer Science disciplines but also from Physics, Maths, Chemistry, Business, Economics, Environmental Science etc. into many different roles which include IC Design, Product Applications, Systems Applications, Test Development, Design Evaluation, Central Applications, Software Development, Packaging, Embedded Software, Reliability, Failure Analysis, Process Development, Finance, Purchasing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Environmental Health and Safety etc. As a valued team member, students at ADI are assigned real work projects that are both meaningful and exciting. Our experienced engineers take their roles as mentors seriously as they want to see you succeed.
Your short-term experience at ADI just might be the launch of a long-term career. At ADI we view your time on placement student as an extended interview. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your abilities and learn more about ADI, while we have an opportunity to assess your potential and consider you for full-time opportunities after graduation. At the conclusion of your placement, we will have a much better understanding of that potential and we hope that you will have decided that ADI is the place for you to start your career.
Why Join ADI?
Competitive Salary, plus relocation assistance
Competitive Holiday Allowance
Learning Opportunities/ Access to Cutting Edge Technology
Placement Specific Initiatives -Ted Talks, College Ambassador etc.
Variety of Networks and Sports & Social Clubs
Subsidised Canteen and Free Tea and Coffee Stations
Onsite Occupational Health Clinic
Cutting edge facilities in our European Research & Design Centre
We will be recruiting for Co-op positions from August/September 2026. Your Co-op term will be aligned to your college assigned Co-op schedule.

HVAC Service Technician
is required by CareerWise Recruitment for our
Co. Cork
based client. The Service Technician is responsible for providing exceptional customer service and technical support. This role plays a crucial role to deliver the highest standards of service in the most efficient manner to maintain customer plant and equipment as installed on site covered by our maintenance and service contract. The goal is to maximize service technician productivity and enhance the overall customer experience and improve operational technical processes. Company Van provided - excellent salary and daily subsistent rate after 5 hours!!
THE ROLE:
Customer and Technical:
Ability to diagnose system problems when servicing products and equipment on assigned projects and customer site visits.
Attend customer sites to carry out work for Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM), Customer Breakdowns, Warranty work, Hire and Commissioning workloads.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted point of contact.
Collaboration with Service desk, Sales, and Operations Team: Establish strong communication channels to share key customer insights.
Able to use cutting edge software and technology, along with a variety of hand-tools, following blueprints or engineering specifications, to diagnose and repair units.
Reporting and Analysis: Generate regular reports on completed invoiced work orders.
Customer Relationship Management: Foster strong relationships with customers through exceptional customer service.
Communications with supervisors, regions service managers and senior technicians, and customers on updates and to drive continuous improvement.
Internal Controls and Administration:
Proven experience in service or field-based technician role.
Strong knowledge of customer service principles.
Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate technicians to deliver customer experiences
Effective communication skills
Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in using, Apps, diagnostic software, and MS Office Suite.
REQUIREMENTS:
Knowledge of manufacturing industry an advantage
People and communication skills with a positive mindset
Able to work with minimal supervision.
Appropriate skilled based certificates with F-Gas
Able to cover standby and call outs on a planned scheduled basis to include weekday, weekends and bank holidays
Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite.
Drivers licence as a company vehicle will be allocated
Right to Work status confirmed for Country of application.

rd

A RF Power Electronics Engineer is required by CareerWise Recruitment to join our based Cork based MN medical device client. Working within a multi-disciplinary R&D team you have responsibility for new product and process development. Permanent role.
Role
* Design, develop, refine and evaluate electrical components, assemblies and subsystems for electrosurgery medical devices.
* Lead the design and implementation of high-energy electrical subsystems for patient-connected medical devices.
* Translate user, clinical and system-level needs into electrical requirements, specifications and system designs.
* Apply concurrent engineering, rapid prototyping and advanced testing methods to accelerate product development while meeting cost, quality and compliance requirements.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring and training to team members on product commercialisation, design trade-offs, technology development and complex engineering challenges.
* Contribute to customer-focused design, voice-of-customer activities, competitive strategy and market understanding in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and contribute to engineering documentation, Design History File (DHF) content, R&D procedures and standards-based development activities.
Requirements
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with at least 6 years of relevant experience.
* Advanced electrical design expertise across complex components and electronic subsystems for medical devices.
* Strong experience in high-frequency power electronics operating from hundreds of kHz to low MHz frequencies, including resonant and quasi-resonant topologies, custom magnetics, high-voltage DC/DC converters and power amplifiers.
* Hands-on experience designing custom magnetics, including high-frequency isolation transformers.
* Strong understanding of RF engineering, electromagnetics, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), measurement systems, sensing and control interfaces, particularly in high dv/dt and high common-mode noise environments.
* Proven ability to guide testing, troubleshooting, PCB and cable design, electrical stack-ups, statistical analysis, and manufacturing and test methods.

jobs.desc:
Job Summary:
This role is responsible for coordinating and continuously improving training and development activities within the Engineering function, ensuring compliance with company, regulatory, and legal requirements. The position is accountable for identifying training needs, developing effective training solutions, and ensuring the timely delivery of training programmes to support organisational and operational objectives. The role holder will work closely with leaders, subject matter experts, and trainers to ensure all colleagues within the Engineering function have the knowledge, skills, and capabilities required to perform their roles effectively.
Job Responsibilities:
Responsible for identifying training needs and coordinating the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of training programmes across the Engineering function.
Monitor training activities to ensure compliance with company, regulatory, and legal requirements.
Conduct training needs analyses and coordinate the identification and assignment of qualified trainers to support effective learning outcomes.
Schedule and coordinate training activities in alignment with Engineering rostering and operational requirements.
Act as the training subject matter expert, providing guidance on all aspects of the training lifecycle, including needs analysis, curriculum development, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.
Support new and transferring colleagues in completing induction and role-based training requirements in accordance with their assigned curricula.
Develop, maintain, and periodically review Job Function Curricula (JFCs) for employees and contractors within the Engineering function.
Coordinate and oversee the PDOCS and QDOCS Periodic Review process within Engineering.
Monitor, analyse, and report training compliance and performance metrics for the Engineering department.
Provide expert guidance and support on training compliance requirements, processes, and related queries.
Identify capability-building, development, and upskilling opportunities across Engineering roles and implement training programmes to address current and future business needs.
Partner with Engineering leaders and subject matter experts to ensure training programmes support operational excellence and workforce capability development.
Safety
Comply with all site safety requirements and actively promote a strong safety culture.
Ensure training activities are conducted in accordance with applicable safety standards and procedures. Training Compliance
Support and monitor training compliance across the Engineering function through reporting, follow-up, and coaching.
Promote accountability for training completion and qualification requirements.
Recognise that ultimate responsibility for training compliance and completion of Job Function Curricula rests with each colleague and their respective people leader. Site Training System: Responsible for management of the systems for procedures and training and implementation of a best-in-class training system for the Engineering Function o Adhere to the site training system and assures compliance with regulatory requirements and internal quality standards GSOP-000006 o Identify training needs through engagement with stakeholders and training needs analyses (TNA/LNA) and develop effective learning solutions to address capability gaps. o Support the site training team with regards to reporting o Support audit readiness, supporting teams with audit readiness activities. o Contribute to the site’s strategy for training and qualification activities o Implement innovative training approaches
